_comment: Which manifest shape each Kramerius 5 document model produces.
Separate from kramerius-70.json because K5's model set is genuinely narrower, not merely older.
Measured live across three instances — nkp 5.8.4.4, nlk 5.8.4.5 and vugtk 5.4.2 — the union is:
page, monograph, monographunit, periodical, periodicalvolume, periodicalitem, supplement,
article, internalpart, chapter, map, sheetmusic, graphic
Note what is ABSENT from every K5 instance measured: soundrecording, soundunit and track (K5 has no
audio model at all), collection, convolute, archive, manuscript, picture and oldprintsheetmusic.
Listing them here would be inventing capability, so they are not listed. If a K5 instance turns up
with one, add it here — that is the point of the table being data.
`chapter` appears only at nlk and holds no pages of its own, so it is a component rather than a
document: requesting one is `unsupported` rather than a manifest with nothing in it.
K5 has no foster relationship, so `fostersPages` is false everywhere: an article's pages are found
through parent_pid like everything else. That is one of the few places K5 is simpler than K7.
_componentsComment: Models that are only ever part of a document. Requesting one is `unsupported`, not `not found` —
the object exists, it simply is not something a manifest can represent.
